data.name: Oddment Conflux
data.detailed_description:
Build the overpowered. Build the weird. Build the thing that shouldn't work but breaks the game anyway. Oddment Conflux is a single-player and small-group RPG where you multiclass however you want. Explore a fractured world, kill creatures, collect loot, experiment endlessly. No pressure, no race.

You are the New Resi, a being who can combine multiple class essences in ways the older generation thought impossible. Tank with fire magic. Control minions while casting spells. Find synergies nobody expects to work. You're not bound by the old faction lines. The world is still figuring out what you are, and so are you.

Kill creatures, earn experience, collect loot, level up, get better gear. Explore the Residuum, a fractured world of strange beauty, from stable forests to surreal dream-touched zones. Push deeper, find harder challenges, better rewards.

The Residuum is a place caught between what it is and what it might become. It has serious moments and genuine lore you can dive into if you want. But it also has a whimsical undertone. Expect weird, unexpected things alongside dark fantasy. We're not taking ourselves too seriously, but we're not joking around either.

Built by gamers, for gamers. We love systems you can dig into. We love finding something that shouldn't work but does. We love playing our way, not the way the game intended.

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600

  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
